Join us for a Rat Public Information Meeting. 

Learn More

 Dec. 10 from 6 p.m. to 8 p.m. at our Boise location. Drop in anytime to learn how you can protect your home and yard from rats and what CDH is doing to tackle the problem in Ada County. Check out our rat information page for more tips on what you can do now: https://cdh.idaho.gov/rats-and-rodent-prevention-in-ada-county/
